Subject: FinTechCorp — Security discovery: incident response timelines & BCP evidence

Hi Amit / security team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the FinTechCorp team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can close the discovery: 

Recap from our call:
- You’re validating vendors for SOC 2 Type II, incident response (IR) readiness, and overall BCP/DR capability.
- Key risk areas: breach notification timelines, historical DR exercise evidence, and HIPAA/GDPR handling for regulated data.

Action items / next steps (proposed):
1) I’m attaching our latest SOC 2 package and IR runbook for preliminary review (see attachments).
2) Please confirm the evidence types you need for BCP/DR (test plans, runbooks, exercise logs, RTO/RPO metrics).
3) We can kick off the vendor security questionnaire — would you prefer a short onboarding call or a link we can share for self-serve completion?
4) Confirm breach notification expectations (you mentioned internal policy of 72 hours for public disclosure) so we can map our notification process.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf, IR_Runbook_v3.docx, BCP_DR_Evidence.zip (redacted logs).

Proposed timeline: deliver SOC2 and IR artifacts now -> you review (3 business days) -> follow-up evidence call week of Aug 3.

If that works I’ll schedule the evidence call and send the vendor questionnaire link.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@fintechcorp.com>

Cc: security@fintechcorp.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-31T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — Security discovery: incident response timelines & BCP evidence

Jordan,

Appreciate the recap and the attachments — quick clarifying questions so we can scope the internal review: 

- SOC 2: Is the attached report a full Type II with the controls mapped to our regulatory needs, or is it an executive summary? We’ll need the full report and the auditor attestation for procurement.
- Breach notification: Our legal/compliance expects vendor notification within 72 hours of discovery for incidents affecting customer data. Can you confirm Redwood’s SLA and whether you disclose root cause analysis and impacted scope in that window, or provide an initial notification with follow-ups?
- HIPAA/GDPR: Our compliance lead asked whether Redwood operates a HIPAA-compliant environment (BAA) or a GDPR data processing addendum. If you don’t cover HIPAA directly, please confirm what controls or offerings you have for protected data.
- For BCP/DR evidence: we commonly request test plans, after-action reports (AARs), and a sample DR exercise log showing RTO/RPO measurements. Is that available in the BCP_DR_Evidence.zip you attached or will that need to be pulled separately?

Also, please share the preferred intake for our vendor security questionnaire — we can push it via our procurement portal or you can send us a link to the questionnaire for self-service completion.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Director, Procurement & Vendor Risk
FinTechCorp
amit.shah@fintechcorp.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@fintechcorp.com>, security@fintechcorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — Security discovery: incident response timelines & BCP evidence

Amit — thanks, answers inline and next steps below.

- SOC 2: The attached "Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf" is the full Type II report plus the CPA attestation. If you need the detailed control matrix mapped to specific regs (e.g., HIPAA/GDPR controls), we can provide a redacted control mapping doc within 24 hours.

- Breach notification SLA: Redwood’s policy is to provide initial notification to customers and named contacts within 72 hours of incident detection. The initial notification contains scope and preliminary impact; a follow-up with full RCA and mitigation actions is provided as more information is validated.

- HIPAA/GDPR: We support GDPR as a data processor and have a DPA available; for HIPAA we offer BAA options for specific private deployments (Dedicated/Private) — I’ve flagged our Solutions lead Marissa to coordinate details if you need a BAA.

- BCP/DR evidence: The BCP_DR_Evidence.zip contains sample DR exercise logs, AARs, and RTO/RPO measurement snapshots. We can provide additional runbooks or raw logs under an NDA.

Vendor questionnaire intake: either works — for speed I can send a secure link to your team (self-serve) and CC procurement so we get visibility. Alternatively, we’ll fill the procurement portal if you prefer.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) I’ll send a secure questionnaire link by EOD today.
2) Marissa will coordinate delivery of the control mapping doc and any BAA discussion items.
3) Shall we tentatively schedule the evidence review call on Aug 4 at 10:00 AM PT?

Links & ref: HubSpot deal FT-2026-0911, evidence bundle Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=abcd1234

Thanks,
Jordan
